scores.key_signal: Western Digital beat expectations across revenue, gross margin, and EPS while reporting year-over-year growth in all major end markets (cloud +29%, client +20%, consumer +17%), signaling a broad-based cyclical recovery in storage demand accelerated by AI-driven storage needs.
scores.name: Western Digital Corp.

scores.key_signal: WEC Energy's record $23.7 billion five-year capital plan, driven by surging data center and industrial demand in the I-94 corridor, signals robust regulated utility investment expansion underpinning 6.5-7% long-term earnings growth.
scores.name: WEC Energy Group, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Welltower's senior housing portfolio delivered 25.5% same-store NOI growth driven by strong occupancy gains and pricing power outpacing expense growth, signaling robust structural demand with constrained new supply supporting continued expansion.
scores.name: Welltower, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Wendy's reaffirmed 3-4% global same-restaurant sales growth guidance for 2024, supported by accelerating digital channel momentum (+35% YoY) and breakfast daypart recovery, though US traffic counts remain negative with growth driven primarily by pricing carryover.
scores.name: The Wendy's Co.

scores.key_signal: Werner's freight market remains deeply challenged with revenues down 8% YoY, ongoing rate pressure, and management warning the cycle could stay 'lower for longer,' signaling continued contraction in trucking demand.
scores.name: Werner Enterprises, Inc.

scores.key_signal: WEX delivered record Q1 revenue of $653M (+7% YoY, +10% ex-fuel/FX) with Corporate Payments volume surging 29% YoY, driven by strong travel payment partnerships including a new preferred-partner agreement with Booking.com, signaling robust forward demand momentum.
scores.name: WEX, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Wells Fargo shows resilient consumer spending and stable credit trends amid declining loan demand and continued headcount reductions, reflecting a cautiously positive but moderating US economic backdrop.
scores.name: Wells Fargo & Co.

scores.key_signal: Weatherford delivered 15% year-over-year revenue growth with 12 consecutive quarters of adjusted EBITDA margin expansion, raising full-year margin guidance to 25%, signaling sustained oilfield services upcycle momentum particularly in international markets.
scores.name: Weatherford International plc

scores.key_signal: Winnebago cut its 2024 RV wholesale shipment forecast and flagged continued dealer destocking, sluggish retail demand, and persistent macroeconomic headwinds from elevated interest rates as the dominant near-term constraint on its business.
scores.name: Winnebago Industries, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Spoolable Technologies segment showed counter-seasonal sequential revenue growth driven by major integrated oil companies and renewed international activity, partially offset by Pressure Control weakness tied to declining US land rig counts in gas basins.
scores.name: Cactus, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Whirlpool faces persistent North America demand softness driven by high interest rates and housing affordability pressures, with price/mix down 375bps, though Latin America and Asia provide partial offset and a 5% price increase aims to improve H2 trajectory.
scores.name: Whirlpool Corp.

scores.key_signal: Wingstop's 21.6% same-store sales growth driven almost entirely by transaction volume — not price — signals exceptionally strong real consumer demand in the fast-casual segment.
scores.name: Wingstop, Inc.

scores.key_signal: World Kinect is deliberately shedding low-margin volume (Aviation bulk activity, Avinode divestiture) to improve unit margins and returns, signaling a margin-over-volume strategic pivot that lifted Aviation gross profit 8% YoY despite a 6% volume decline.
scores.name: World Kinect Corp.

scores.key_signal: HIP segment posted record Q1 EBITDA with 14% volume growth, but weak PEM pricing—particularly caustic soda, PVC, and epoxy resins under pressure from Asian dumping—drove year-over-year net income down $220 million, signaling a bifurcated recovery with materials chemicals still in contraction.
scores.name: Westlake Corp.

scores.key_signal: Wiley is emerging as an early beneficiary of GenAI content licensing demand, executing $44M in AI content deals and exceeding cost-savings and EBITDA guidance, signaling a positive inflection in its publishing business model.
scores.name: John Wiley & Sons, Inc.

scores.key_signal: WM raised full-year operating EBITDA and free cash flow guidance by $100M each, driven by 240bps margin expansion and sustained pricing power, signaling strong operational momentum in the waste services sector.
scores.name: Waste Management, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Williams delivered 8% EBITDA growth despite a 25% year-over-year decline in natural gas prices, with 20 high-return projects in execution and surging demand from data centers and industrial reshoring driving pipeline and storage expansion.
scores.name: The Williams Cos., Inc.

scores.key_signal: Warner Music Group delivered 9% normalized total revenue growth with streaming subscription revenue up 13.5%, driven by both subscriber growth and price increases, signaling durable pricing power in digital music distribution.
scores.name: Warner Music Group Corp.

scores.key_signal: ADS delivered its ninth consecutive year of record profitability with adjusted EBITDA margins expanding 270bps to 32.1% despite a 6% revenue decline, signaling strong pricing power and operational resilience, with forward guidance pointing to high-single-digit infrastructure growth and mid-single-digit residential growth in fiscal 2025.
scores.name: Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Walmart's unit volume and transaction count growth with market share gains in general merchandise — driven by price leadership rather than inflation — signals resilient consumer demand and competitive positioning in a deflationary general merchandise environment.
scores.name: Walmart, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Worthington's ASME tank business for data center liquid cooling is accelerating rapidly — matching full-year FY2026 revenue in Q1 FY2027 alone — signaling strong industrial demand tied to AI infrastructure buildout.
scores.name: Worthington Enterprises, Inc.

scores.key_signal: W.R. Berkley posted record quarterly operating income with 53.4% growth and accelerating net premiums written growth of 10.7%, signaling strong insurance demand and continued pricing power in the commercial insurance market.
scores.name: W.R. Berkley Corp.

scores.key_signal: World Acceptance is emerging from a two-year credit tightening cycle with improving delinquency rates (60+ day down 9%, net charge-offs down 500+ bps) and returning to modest loan growth in FY2025, signaling stabilization in subprime consumer credit quality.
scores.name: World Acceptance Corp.

scores.key_signal: WillScot Mobile Mini reported Q1 results in line with expectations and reaffirmed 2024 outlook, with strategic integration milestones and the pending McGrath acquisition pointing to modest organic growth supported by operational efficiency gains rather than strong demand acceleration.
scores.name: WillScot Mobile Mini Holdings Corp.

scores.key_signal: WSFS posted solid Q1 loan growth of 7% annualized with stable deposit growth and a healthy NIM of 3.84%, signaling continued credit expansion demand in its regional banking franchise.
scores.name: WSFS Financial Corp.

scores.key_signal: Williams-Sonoma demonstrated resilient pricing power and margin strength (19.5% operating margin) even as comparable sales declined 4.9%, signaling premium home goods demand remains under pressure but the company is defending profitability through supply chain efficiencies and full-price selling discipline.
scores.name: Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Despite soft residential HVAC unit demand, Watsco achieved record Q1 sales through price realization and richer product mix, with April trends accelerating to mid-single-digit same-store growth ahead of the summer selling season.
scores.name: Watsco, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Ongoing customer destocking continues to weigh on near-term demand with organic sales declining 3% in Q1, though management signals a stronger second-half recovery with Q4 expected to be the strongest quarter.
scores.name: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc.

scores.key_signal: WisdomTree achieved record AUM of $107.2 billion with $2 billion in net inflows and 18% year-over-year revenue growth, driven by higher-fee product demand and margin expansion, signaling healthy organic growth momentum in the asset management sector.
scores.name: WisdomTree, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Wintrust reported record net income and broad-based loan growth of ~10% annualized, signaling solid credit demand, though NIM compression to 3.5% and declining non-interest-bearing deposits indicate ongoing funding cost pressure.
scores.name: Wintrust Financial Corp.

scores.key_signal: Essential Utilities is executing a record $1.3-1.4B capital investment program in 2024, signaling strong regulated utility infrastructure spending driven partly by PFAS compliance requirements.
scores.name: Essential Utilities, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Watts Water posted record Q1 sales and margins driven by extra shipping days and acquisitions, but faces meaningful headwinds from weakening European construction, declining heat pump OEM volumes, and higher-for-longer interest rates pressuring new construction in the second half of 2024.
scores.name: Watts Water Technologies, Inc.

scores.key_signal: WTW delivered 5% organic revenue growth with 200bps margin expansion and a robust new business pipeline, signaling continued demand for risk and benefits advisory services in the current economic environment.
scores.name: Willis Towers Watson Plc

scores.key_signal: Western Union's Consumer Money Transfer transactions grew 6% for a third consecutive quarter of 5%+ growth — the strongest sustained transaction momentum in nearly a decade — signaling resilient global remittance demand despite elevated inflation and higher interest rates.
scores.name: The Western Union Co.

scores.key_signal: Woodward delivered significant year-over-year sales growth and margin expansion across both Aerospace and Industrial segments, driven by strong commercial aviation demand and operational excellence gains, though OEM build rate uncertainty warrants monitoring.
scores.name: Woodward, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Wolverine World Wide achieved an all-time record gross margin in Q1 2024 while exceeding revenue expectations, signaling successful pricing and supply chain cost improvements even as top-line volumes remain in turnaround mode.
scores.name: Wolverine World Wide, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Weyerhaeuser posted a 10% sequential EBITDA increase driven by wood products recovery and real estate transactions, but lumber remains marginally unprofitable and log supply pressures from mill curtailments and China inventory buildup signal continued housing/timber demand softness.
scores.name: Weyerhaeuser Co.

scores.key_signal: Wynn delivered all-time record quarterly EBITDAR of $647M driven by strong demand in both Las Vegas and Macau, with Macau mass drop per day up 30% vs 2019 levels, signaling robust global luxury gaming demand recovery.
scores.name: Wynn Resorts Ltd.

scores.key_signal: Xcel Energy faces significant wildfire liability headwinds (~$215M accrued) but maintains robust long-term capital investment pipeline with 6,400+ MW of new resource additions planned, signaling steady regulated growth offset by near-term risk.
scores.name: Xcel Energy, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Group demand is the key growth driver, with group room revenues up 8.1% ex-Scottsdale, while business transient is recovering and leisure is normalizing, suggesting a healthy but uneven hospitality demand environment.
scores.name: Xenia Hotels & Resorts, Inc.

scores.key_signal: ExxonMobil delivered $8.2B in earnings and $14.7B in cash flow in Q1 2024, with structural cost savings hitting $10.1B vs 2019 and a clear growth trajectory toward $12B additional earnings potential by 2027, signaling robust operational momentum in the energy sector.
scores.name: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp.

scores.key_signal: XPEL reported only 5% revenue growth with US up just 1.9%, citing broad consumer weakness, EV market cooling, and port delays as compounding headwinds, though a stronger April provides a tentative sequential recovery signal.
scores.name: XPEL, Inc.

scores.key_signal: XPO's LTL segment delivered 9.8% yield growth ex-fuel and 37% adjusted EBITDA improvement despite a soft freight market, signaling strong pricing power and operational momentum even in a challenging transport demand environment.
scores.name: XPO, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Dentsply Sirona's organic sales declined 1.9% in Q1 2024, trending toward the low end of full-year guidance due to persistent macro headwinds in imaging equipment and weak demand in Germany and Asia Pacific markets.
scores.name: Dentsply Sirona, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Yelp's Home Services segment shows solid 15% revenue growth and 20% increase in request-a-quote projects, but overall business is constrained by weakness in restaurants/retail categories facing elevated input costs and inability to pass through inflation to consumers.
scores.name: Yelp, Inc.

scores.key_signal: YETI delivered double-digit growth across channels with a 450-basis-point gross margin expansion driven by inbound freight recovery, product cost improvements, and strong pricing discipline, signaling robust consumer demand resilience at premium price points.
scores.name: YETI Holdings, Inc.

scores.key_signal: CLEAR's 35% revenue growth and 285% adjusted EBITDA expansion signal strong consumer demand for identity verification services, with active ARPU gap closure and TSA PreCheck launch providing durable forward growth catalysts.
scores.name: Clear Secure, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Yum! Brands maintained 6% core operating profit growth guidance despite same-store sales pressure across KFC and Pizza Hut, with Taco Bell outperforming peers on margins and digital sales crossing 50% of system sales for the first time, signaling resilient pricing power in a challenged consumer environment.
scores.name: Yum! Brands, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Zimmer Biomet's pricing dynamics improved to roughly flat versus historical 200-300 bps erosion, signaling meaningful pricing power recovery in the orthopedic device space alongside healthy end-market demand driven by demographic tailwinds.
scores.name: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Zebra is emerging from a deep inventory destocking cycle with sequential demand improvement and raised full-year guidance, but broad-based recovery remains elusive with year-over-year sales still down ~17% and particular weakness in China and Asia-Pacific.
scores.name: Zebra Technologies Corp.

scores.key_signal: Ziff Davis returned to 2.4% revenue growth after six quarters of flat or declining revenues, signaling a tentative inflection point in digital media and cybersecurity demand, though offset by ongoing weakness in the Shopping vertical.
scores.name: Ziff Davis, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Revenue declined 11% year-over-year as net interest margin compression remains the dominant headwind, though loan pipelines show early signs of recovery and credit quality remains benign at just 4 basis points net charge-offs.
scores.name: Zions Bancorporation NA

scores.key_signal: Zurn Elkay beat Q1 expectations on sales, earnings, and cash flow, raising full-year EBITDA margin guidance to 150-200bps expansion, driven by productivity synergies and lower material/transportation costs.
scores.name: Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corp.
